verdict.rationale: There is only indirect evidence that SendGrid supports multi-tenant isolation: a community mention of a main account plus three sub-accounts (sendgrid-comm-9) and a reference to 'EU regional subusers' with a dedicated base URL (sendgrid-docs-16), plus domain authentication per sending domain (sendgrid-docs-9). However, none of the evidence documents subuser-level credentials, per-subuser suppression lists, or dedicated IP/reputation isolation in depth. missing for 10: first-party docs on Subuser Management API, per-subuser suppression list isolation, dedicated IP pools/reputation separation, and independent corroboration of tenant isolation at scale.
